stem.text: Centrioles, cilia, microtubules and microvilli are structures found in eukaryotic cells.
Which statement about these cellular structures is correct?

A.text: Centrioles, cilia and microvilli are composed of microtubules.

B.text: Centrioles play a role in mitosis and semi-conservative DNA replication.

C.text: Cilia and microvilli both increase the cell surface area for absorption.

D.text: Microtubules are made of protein and form the spindle in mitosis.
